body:
Iris (arch): Quick RFC follow-up: we keep accumulating small "orphaned" shims that nobody owns but still get occasional hits. Proposal: classify orphaned shims and run a quarterly sunset sweep with safety gates. Thoughts?

Noah: Agree. Need classification: orphaned-unused (no hits), orphaned-low (sporadic hits <2/day), orphaned-active (>=2/day). Only auto-remove orphaned-unused. Low should trigger owner-hunt + 60d notice.

Dana: Ops note: shadow-mirroring for low shims for 14d before prune. Also, require a ticket check: exclude any shim referenced in support tickets in last 180d.

support-bot: created search: tickets referencing shim -> SUP-ORPH-2025 (staging).

Iris (arch): Safe prune conditions proposal: no hits for 90d OR low hits (<2/day) AND unique_tenants < 3 AND mirror-diff <0.05% on 1% sample. Also add a contract/compliance hold label to exempt tenants.

Noah: Add a TTL to the orphaned tag (e.g., mark orphaned at t0, auto-sweep t0+120d). Notify tenants via outbound email + console banner at 30/14/7/1 days.

Dana: We must keep per-tenant revert flags for 7 days after removal. Also write immutable audit record with the sample diffs S3 key.

infra-bot: feature-flag created: compat.orphaned.sweep (staging).

Iris (arch): Action items: @Noah implement classification + notices, @Dana wire mirror-run + audit artifact, @Support add ticket-exclusion query, I'll add RFC appendix with thresholds. Sync next Mon to lock numbers.

Noah: ack

Dana: ack

support-bot: queued: notify-team #retire-review
